<div class="card-body">
'''Magnetic Suction Tube (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">磁気吸引ダクト</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分のサンドクローラーに配備する。自分の支配フェイズに、同じ場所にいるキャラクターを一人目標として選べる。運命数を引く。運命数＞キャラクターの能力値なら、そのキャラクターを“吸い上げる”（対応するサンドクローラーの内部位置カードか、持ち主のユーズドデッキに移動する）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Magnetic-Suction-Tube-Dark-PSA-164793251.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「シュポ」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Magnetic suction duct.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on your Sandcrawler. During your control phase, you may target one character at the same place. Draw destiny. If destiny > the character's ability, “suck up” that character (move it to a related interior Sandcrawler location card or the owner's Used Pile).

'''Lore:'''
“Slurp.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed lore is 「シュポ」.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Magnetic Suction Tube (Dark)]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
